scope: Manual editorial review of the actual original99 small reproductions. Only narrative and atmosphere keys reviewed; no catalogue or saved record edits.

narrative.label: Depicted action
narrative.definition: Visible activity of figures or animals and clearly depicted physical events such as breaking waves or fire. Not a story inferred from the title, symbolism, emotional tension, or energetic brushwork alone.

anchors.0: No visible action; abstraction, still life, a static portrait or an inactive body.
anchors.0.3: Quiet visible activity or restrained gestures.
anchors.0.5: Clear bodily movement, handling or a substantial physical event.
anchors.0.9: Prominent mid-action conflict, vigorous movement or collective activity.

atmosphere.label: Emphasis on setting
atmosphere.definition: How strongly a represented place and its surroundings occupy and organise the composition. Not emotional mood, lighting drama alone, decorative pattern or an unspecified plain background.

anchors.0: No represented place or a plain ground.
anchors.0.25: Sparse furniture, ground or other limited environmental cues.
anchors.0.5: A substantial but shared or partial interior/landscape.
anchors.0.9: The surrounding landscape, architecture or spatial environment dominates.

method.imageSet: Original small work.image files, not replacement high-resolution photographs.
method.resolution: 0.05 increments are editorial ordering aids, not measured precision.
method.uncertainty: Borderline still-life architecture, schematic icon grounds and stylised natural motion admit different readings. These scores are not experimental ground truth.
method.distribution: No balancing, percentile fitting, or adjustment to force a preferred coordinate distribution.

frozenRecordPolicy: Apply only to the current new catalogue. Previously captured work/features remain source-frozen; do not rewrite historical answers, saved annotations or captured question snapshots.
